shots.intent: 搜索列表第一眼，用干净直身轮廓与完整顶盖赢下点击

style.backgroundSystem: seamless clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, split screens and spec screens; warm stone-grey #F2EFE9 for benefit and detail screens; weathered dark walnut plank #4A382A only for the single lifestyle scene
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin-line icons in deep steel-blue #1D3557, one icon per screen maximum
style.lightingSystem: neutral soft studio light, large front-left key with a low fill card, controlled speculars on brushed metal, soft contact shadows, no harsh hotspots
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent rugged-premium drinkware e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm stone-grey #F2EFE9, charcoal #26282B and one deep steel-blue accent #1D3557; neutral soft studio lighting with a large front-left key, low fill card and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif held for post-composed copy only; single-weight thin-line icon style in the accent colour; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic blocks and empty label frames; stable upright product scale and one consistent slight 3/4 or straight-on reading angle; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no rendered words or numbers.
noDrift: no rendered words, numbers or units anywhere in frame
no brand marks or embossed lettering on any part
style.presentationRules: the vessel stays upright and full-height at one stable scale; the same slight 3/4 or straight-on reading angle repeats across screens; separated parts lie on one shared plane
style.surfaceSystem: matte pale stone board #F2EFE9 for studio screens, weathered dark walnut plank #4A382A for the scene
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif held for post-composed copy only; all in-image words stay as blank frames
